Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000420": As of 2025-06-05, Marcus is the Team Boreal on-call primary instead of Lena.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000417": As of 2025-06-05, Lena is off the Team Boreal on-call rotation.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena)
- memory_id "1000413": On 2025-05-23, the Ember team flagged that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout, noting the webhooks service is not their service.  (about: webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000371": On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal flagged that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, noting the catalog service is not their service.  (about: Team Boreal, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000367" [constraint]: The billing service only ships on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000298": As of 2025-04-04, the notifier lives with Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, notifier)
- memory_id "1000283": As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service.  (about: Team Boreal, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000271": As of 2025-03-28, the webhooks service lives with Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000267": As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000232": The ledger relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down.  (about: ledger, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000225": As of 2025-03-17, the billing service lives with Team Boreal.  (about: Team Boreal, billing service)
- memory_id "1000222": Tomasz Nowak wrote the billing-api handover doc for Marcus on 2025-03-17.  (about: Tomasz Nowak, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000208": The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings.  (about: ledger, billing service)
- memory_id "1000196": On 2025-02-27, Team Boreal noticed the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Boreal, feature-flags service)
- memory_id "1000180": Team Cinder flagged that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade.  (about: Team Cinder, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000150": INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000117": The webhooks service depends on the event bus for outbound events.  (about: event bus, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000114": The notifier depends on the event bus for delivery events.  (about: event bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000082": Lena takes the first Boreal on-call shift of the year.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena)
- memory_id "1000011": As of January 2025, the Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena, Marcus)
